statistics: median/min/max of 3 independent process values; repeated-call means first computed within each process; values in round order; no significance/p95 claims

resources.cpu_accounting: C++ and coordinator measured CPU plus 16 x non-C++ workflow wall time; includes baseline conservative build/workflow bounds. Upper budget accounting, not measured CPU usage.
resources.gpu_memory: pre/post and phase snapshots plus allocation caps; not continuous peak sampling
